_readme: Copy to autopilot.json. Times are in 'timezone'. Each channel posts at most once per slot, and all channels together post at most 'daily_upload_limit' a day (the YouTube API allows about 6 uploads a day until Google raises your quota). vertical_style: 'blur' keeps the whole 16:9 picture over a blurred background, 'crop' fills the screen with the middle of it.
